errors.message: Streamable HTTP error: Error POSTing to endpoint: {"error": "login_required", "error_description": "Priorbit needs a uselawless.com account (Go is free, 200 credits a month); create one at https://uselawless.com/login?returnTo=%2Faccount&mode=signup . How to sign in: Codex → if a Codex sign-in window is already open, finish it there; otherwise run `codex mcp login priorbit` once (one browser tab opens), then restart Codex. Claude Code → type /mcp, pick priorbit, choose Authenticate. Cowork / claude.ai → open the Priorbit connector and click Sign in. Plugin older than 0.4.2? Re-run `codex plugin add priorbit@lawless` or `claude plugin install priorbit@lawless` to update, then sign in. / Priorbit 需要一个 uselawless.com 账号(Go 免费, 每月 200 积分), 在 https://uselawless.com/login?returnTo=%2Faccount&mode=signup 注册。登录方法: Codex 如果已经弹出登录窗口就在那里登录; 没有的话运行一次 `codex mcp login priorbit`(只开一个浏览器标签页), 然后重启 Codex; Claude Code 输入 /mcp 选 priorbit 再选 Authenticate; Cowork / claude.ai 在 Priorbit 连接器里点登录。插件低于 0.4.2 的先重新运行安装命令更新。"}
